import Data.List (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)
import LeasedDomain (..)
import LeasedRunner (leased_snapshot)

fn status_step(status : StepStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Pending => "pending"
    Running => "running"
    Succeeded => "succeeded"
    Failed => "failed"
    Blocked => "blocked"
    Cancelled => "cancelled"

fn status_run(status : RunStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Active => "active"
    Completed => "succeeded"
    RunFailed => "failed"
    Failing => "failing"
    Cancelling => "cancelling"
    RunCancelled => "cancelled"

fn lease_json(lease : Option(Lease)) : Json =
  match lease of
    None => JNull
    Some(value) => JObj([("worker", JStr(value.worker)), ("ticket", JInt(value.ticket)),
      ("expires", JInt(value.expires))])

fn step_json(step : LeasedStep) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(step.id)), ("status", JStr(status_step(step.status))),
    ("attempts", JInt(step.attempts)), ("ready_at", JInt(step.ready_at)),
    ("lease", lease_json(step.lease))])

fn run_json(run : LeasedRun) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(run.id)), ("status", JStr(status_run(run.status))),
    ("cancel_requested", JBool(run.cancel_requested)), ("steps", JArr(map(step_json, run.steps)))])

fn worker_json(worker : WorkerState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(worker.id)), ("up", JBool(worker.up))])

fn snapshot_fields(snapshot : LeasedSnapshot) : List((String, Json)) =
  [("now", JInt(snapshot.now)), ("workers", JArr(map(worker_json, snapshot.workers))),
    ("runs", JArr(map(run_json, snapshot.runs)))]

fn snapshot_json(snapshot : LeasedSnapshot) : Json = JObj(snapshot_fields(snapshot))

fn value_json(value : CommandValue) : Json =
  match value of
    NullValue => JNull
    SnapshotValue(snapshot) => snapshot_json(snapshot)
    TicketValue(ticket) =>
      let value = match ticket of
        Some(id) => JInt(id)
        None => JNull
      JObj([("ticket", value)])
    RenewedValue(value) => JObj([("renewed", JBool(value))])
    ReceiptValue(kind, outcome) => JObj([("kind", JStr(kind)), ("outcome", JStr(outcome))])
    StaleValue => JObj([("outcome", JStr("stale"))])
    CommittedValue(value) => JObj([("committed", JBool(value))])

fn key_json(key : ActionKey) : Json = JArr([JStr(key.run_id), JStr(key.step_id)])

fn call_json(call : LeasedCall) : Json =
  JObj([("worker", JStr(call.worker)), ("ticket", JInt(call.ticket)),
    ("kind", JStr(call.kind)), ("key", key_json(call.key)),
    ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call.outcome))])

fn effect_json(entry : Effect) : Json =
  JObj([("key", key_json(entry.key)), ("amount", JInt(entry.amount))])

pub fn leased_result_json(sim : LeasedSimulator) : Json =
  let final = append(snapshot_fields(leased_snapshot(sim)),
    [("calls", JArr(map(call_json, sim.service.calls))),
      ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, sim.service.effects)))])
  JObj([("results", JArr(map(value_json, sim.results))), ("final", JObj(final))])

pub fn leased_response_json(result : Result(LeasedSimulator, String)) : Json =
  match result of
    Ok(sim) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", leased_result_json(sim))])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)
import LeasedDomain (..)
import Validation (..)

fn parse_workers(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) = parse_ids(xs)

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(worker) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(worker) else LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(worker, ticket) else LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LeasedCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok([])
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

pub fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)) && not(is_nil(raw_workers)) && length(raw_workers) <= 100
    && length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let workers = parse_workers(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LeasedWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = duration })

pub fn parse_leased_request(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let version = match get_field(obj, "protocol_version") of
    JInt(1) => Ok(())
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = version?
  let task = match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) => ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = task?
  parse_leased_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

pub fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

pub fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

pub fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

pub fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

pub fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

pub fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

fn protocol_version(value : Json) : Result(Unit, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(1) => Ok(())
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn task_name(value : Json) : Result(Unit, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(name) => ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let _ = protocol_version(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"))?
  let _ = task_name(get_field(obj, "task"))?
  parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

defs.name: lease_live
defs.source: fn lease_live(now : Int, lease : Lease) : Bool = now < lease.expires

defs.name: current_live
defs.source:
fn current_live(sim : LeasedSimulator, ticket : Ticket) : Bool =
  match find(\(run) -> run.id == ticket.run_id, sim.runs) of
    None => false
    Some(run) =>
      match find(\(step) -> step.id == ticket.step_id, run.steps) of
        None => false
        Some(step) =>
          match step.lease of
            Some(lease) => lease.ticket == ticket.id && lease_live(sim.now, lease)
            None => false

defs.name: held_by
defs.source:
fn held_by(now : Int, id : String, step : LeasedStep) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    Some(lease) => lease.worker == id && lease_live(now, lease)
    None => false

defs.name: worker_busy
defs.source:
fn worker_busy(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Bool =
  any(\(run) -> any(\(step) -> held_by(sim.now, id, step), run.steps), sim.runs)

fn expired_running(now : Int, step : LeasedStep) : Bool =

fn deliver(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, ticket_id : Int) : Result(LeasedSimulator, String) =
  match find(\(entry) -> entry.id == ticket_id, sim.tickets) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(ticket) =>
      let owner = owner_for(sim.workers, ticket.worker)
      if ticket.delivered || not(owner.up) || not(current_live(sim, ticket)) then
        Ok(with_result(sim, CommittedValue(false)))
      else
        match ticket.response of
          None => Ok(with_result(sim, CommittedValue(false)))
          Some(outcome) =>
            let run = run_for(sim.runs, ticket.run_id)
            let step = step_for(run.steps, ticket.step_id)
            let committed = deliver_response(sim, workflow, ticket, run, step, outcome)?
            Ok(with_result(committed, CommittedValue(true)))

fn cancel_run(sim : LeasedSimulator, id : String) : Result(LeasedSimulator, String) =
  match find(\(run) -> run.id == id, sim.runs) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
    Some(run) =>
      if run.status == Completed || run.status == RunFailed || run.status == RunCancelled
          || run.status == Failing || run.status == Cancelling then Ok(with_result(sim, NullValue))
      else
        let cancelled = map(\(step) -> expire_running(sim.now, cancel_pending(step)), run.steps)
        let status = if any(\(step) -> step.status == Running, cancelled) then Cancelling else RunCancelled
        let updated = LeasedRun { ..run, status = status, cancel_requested = true, steps = cancelled }
        Ok(with_result(replace_run(sim, updated), NullValue))

defs.name: parse_command
defs.source:
fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(worker) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(worker) else LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(worker, ticket) else LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)) && not(is_nil(raw_workers)) && length(raw_workers) <= 100
    && length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let workers = parse_workers(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LeasedWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = duration })

fn parse_leased_request(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =

    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = version?
  let task = match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) => ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = task?
  parse_leased_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))
